steps.en: Install it from the Claude Code plugin marketplace
steps.zh: 从 Claude Code 插件市场安装

steps.en: Run setup once to activate the verbs, hooks, and guardrails
steps.zh: 跑一次 setup，激活动词、钩子和护栏

steps.en: Wires a Go engine into the PreToolUse hook — each file write and command is inspected before it runs
steps.zh: 把 Go 引擎接进 PreToolUse 钩子：写文件和命令执行前先过检查

steps.en: Hand it your intent plus the completion criterion
steps.zh: 把意图和完成标准交给它

steps.en: Inspects the code and writes spec.md + Plans.md: scope, acceptance criteria, unknowns, stop conditions
steps.zh: 写出 spec.md + Plans.md：范围、验收标准、未知项、停止条件

steps.en: Approve or correct the contract, then start the plan
steps.zh: 批准或修正契约，然后启动计划

steps.en: Implements under the plan, runs required checks, and sends review findings back to the worker
steps.zh: 按计划实现，跑必需检查，review 发现退回 worker 修正

steps.en: Packages only verified evidence into CHANGELOG, tag, and release
steps.zh: 只把验证过的证据打包成 changelog、tag 和 release

value.en: You approve two contracts; the agent can no longer grade its own homework, and risky commands are inspected before they run
value.zh: 你只批准两份契约；agent 不再自己给自己打分，危险命令执行前先被拦下检查

sources: README.md Install in 30 seconds (marketplace add + /plugin install claude-code-harness@claude-code-harness-marketplace + /harness-setup, then /harness-plan ...)
README.md The loop table (/harness-plan writes spec.md + Plans.md; /harness-work, /harness-review, /harness-release verbs and gates)
README.md What happens after a request (worker implements, checks run, review findings returned to worker within the iteration limit)
go/DESIGN.md (Go-native guardrail engine: internal/guardrail rules.go declarative rule table, pre_tool.go deny/allow verdicts)
